name: The film — the soft launch, beside the shots it is made of
the launch film
notes 1
code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1760 233" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMin meet" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace"><text x="0" y="30.0" font-size="30" font-weight="600" xml:space="preserve">dyna.ink — a shot list, drawn on dyna.ink</text><text x="0" y="73.5" font-size="30" xml:space="preserve">Sixteen shots for what the canvas is for: maths, physics, reasoning and design.</text><text x="0" y="117.0" font-size="30" xml:space="preserve">Each shot is a region — its sketch, what it shows, and room under it for you.</text><text x="0" y="160.5" font-size="30" xml:space="preserve">BUILT shots are live: point at or hold their sketches and the canvas answers.</text><text x="0" y="204.0" font-size="30" xml:space="preserve">SPECCED is in the spec, PROPOSED is new — neither is built yet.</text></svg>

name: notes 2
code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1760 233" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMin meet" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace"><text x="0" y="30.0" font-size="30" font-weight="600" xml:space="preserve">How to comment</text><text x="0" y="73.5" font-size="30" xml:space="preserve">Draw or write anywhere: circle a shot you love, scratch one out, arrow a new order.</text><text x="0" y="117.0" font-size="30" xml:space="preserve">Double-click empty ground to type a note; drag a shot by its title to reorder.</text><text x="0" y="160.5" font-size="30" xml:space="preserve">The outline in the panel lists every shot, and Find looks for any word.</text><text x="0" y="204.0" font-size="30" xml:space="preserve">Then export board + pictures and send the file back — I read your marks with the engine.</text></svg>

name: notes 3
code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 279" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMin meet" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace"><text x="0" y="23.0" font-size="23" font-weight="600" xml:space="preserve">BUILT — in the app today</text><text x="0" y="56.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">DO   rule three lines, a small square in the corner,</text><text x="0" y="89.7" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     write the two legs</text><text x="0" y="123.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SEE  the long side appears beside the drawing, worked out</text><text x="0" y="156.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SAY  it does the arithmetic the drawing implies</text><text x="0" y="189.8" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">WHY  maths on the page, read from the ink — no model</text><text x="0" y="223.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     asked</text><text x="0" y="256.5" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">TRY  point at the triangle in this frame</text></svg>

name: notes 4
code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 279" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMin meet" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace"><text x="0" y="23.0" font-size="23" font-weight="600" xml:space="preserve">BUILT — in the app today</text><text x="0" y="56.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">DO   change the waist on the page</text><text x="0" y="89.7" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SEE  only the steps that use it change, each with its</text><text x="0" y="123.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     check</text><text x="0" y="156.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SAY  change flows, the ink stays</text><text x="0" y="189.8" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">WHY  the page is a pure function of its lines — undo</text><text x="0" y="223.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     springs it back</text><text x="0" y="256.5" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">TRY  double-click the page and change the waist</text></svg>

code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 312" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMin meet" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace"><text x="0" y="23.0" font-size="23" font-weight="600" xml:space="preserve">BUILT — in the app today</text><text x="0" y="56.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">DO   draw a piece with its grain line, notches and a seam</text><text x="0" y="89.7" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     allowance</text><text x="0" y="123.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SEE  cut and sewn sizes beside it, then the print — a</text><text x="0" y="156.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     test square on every page</text><text x="0" y="189.8" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SAY  from a sketch to scissors</text><text x="0" y="223.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">WHY  the drawing has a real size, and a printer cannot</text><text x="0" y="256.5" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     fake it</text><text x="0" y="289.8" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">TRY  hold the piece here and read what it says it is</text></svg>

name: Shot 3 · A pattern piece, printed at true size
notes 6
code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 279" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMin meet" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace"><text x="0" y="23.0" font-size="23" font-weight="600" xml:space="preserve">BUILT — in the app today</text><text x="0" y="56.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">DO   type an equals sign and a sum, with the page’s own</text><text x="0" y="89.7" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     names</text><text x="0" y="123.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SEE  the answer before Enter, then the words stand on the</text><text x="0" y="156.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     board</text><text x="0" y="189.8" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SAY  the canvas is a calculator that reads your page</text><text x="0" y="223.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">WHY  tier one does the arithmetic, never a model</text><text x="0" y="256.5" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">TRY  hold a mark, type = and a sum</text></svg>

name: Shot 4 · Ask a sum, in the field
Maths — the numbers a drawing implies
notes 7
code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 279" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMin meet" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace"><text x="0" y="23.0" font-size="23" font-weight="600" xml:space="preserve">PROPOSED — a new idea, nothing built</text><text x="0" y="56.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">DO   draw a pivot, a rod and a weight</text><text x="0" y="89.7" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SEE  it is read as a pendulum and starts to swing; its</text><text x="0" y="123.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     length sets the period</text><text x="0" y="156.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SAY  Chalktalk’s road — the drawing is the simulation</text><text x="0" y="189.8" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">WHY  a reading becomes a model you can poke</text><text x="0" y="223.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">NEED a physics notation and a step in the clock — not in</text><text x="0" y="256.5" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     the engine yet</text></svg>

name: Shot 5 · Draw a pendulum, it swings
notes 8
code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 312" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMin meet" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace"><text x="0" y="23.0" font-size="23" font-weight="600" xml:space="preserve">BUILT — in the app today</text><text x="0" y="56.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">DO   draw a fish, name it, write what it does in a few</text><text x="0" y="89.7" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     words</text><text x="0" y="123.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SEE  every fish like it swims by those words — wander,</text><text x="0" y="156.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     flee what is bigger</text><text x="0" y="189.8" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SAY  verbs from words, no code</text><text x="0" y="223.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">WHY  the words are read into a closed set of verbs, and</text><text x="0" y="256.5" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     undo re-runs the tank</text><text x="0" y="289.8" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">TRY  drag a body while it plays to act a behaviour out</text></svg>

name: Shot 6 · A tank of drawn creatures, told what to do in words
notes 9
code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 279" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMin meet" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace"><text x="0" y="23.0" font-size="23" font-weight="600" xml:space="preserve">PROPOSED — a new idea, nothing built</text><text x="0" y="56.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">DO   draw a block on a ramp and an arrow for each force</text><text x="0" y="89.7" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SEE  the arrows read as vectors, summed tip to tail; the</text><text x="0" y="123.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     block slides the way the sum points</text><text x="0" y="156.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SAY  a free-body diagram that runs</text><text x="0" y="189.8" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">WHY  an arrow’s length and heading are already measured —</text><text x="0" y="223.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     the sum is not built</text><text x="0" y="256.5" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">NEED a vector notation and a run</text></svg>

name: notes 13
code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 279" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMin meet" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace"><text x="0" y="23.0" font-size="23" font-weight="600" xml:space="preserve">BUILT — in the app today</text><text x="0" y="56.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">DO   draw something two of your definitions both match</text><text x="0" y="89.7" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SEE  Which is it? is offered; one tap asks a decision</text><text x="0" y="123.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     model, its answer held beside the engine’s</text><text x="0" y="156.4" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">SAY  a second opinion, only when you ask</text><text x="0" y="189.8" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">WHY  a model is asked by a deliberate act, and its answer</text><text x="0" y="223.1" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">     never evicts the engine’s</text><text x="0" y="256.5" font-size="23" xml:space="preserve">NEED a decider seat joined in the models pane</text></svg>

name: Design — sketches that become the thing
YOUR SHOTS — draw the ones I missed here
